schema:name: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method
schema:description: laSficpmsTAPP instance derived from Chernonozhkin et al. 2021 (Chem Geol 562) Pallasite olivine Line scan (Run 1: major) + Spot (Run 2: trace) [Multi-run] ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Ghent University (publication column of LA-SF-ICP-MS_TAPP_v16.xlsx).

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Same instrument as mapping; tuning optimized per run (different RF power and resolution settings per run)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Washout time: 11 s between runs (runs include 400 µm line + blank + washout)

schema:location.schema:name: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

schema:creator.schema:name: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.

ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy thick section; pre-ablated before trace element run
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: PMG thick sections polished; pre-ablation pass (2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 150 µm square, 300 µm s⁻¹) before trace element run
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
ada:interfaceConeConfiguration: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
ada:massResolutionSettingDefault: Run 1: Medium resolution (M/ΔM = 4000) for major elements; Run 2: Low resolution (M/ΔM = 300) for trace elements
ada:detectorConfiguration: Triple mode detection; Faraday used for major elements in run 1
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault: Run 1 (major): 30 µm circular; Run 2 (trace): 130 µm circular
ada:laserSpotPathAblationMode: Transect (line scan, run 1) + Spot (run 2 on same location after pre-ablation)
ada:laserFluenceDefault: Run 1 (major): 4.72 J cm⁻²; Run 2 (trace): 4.72 J cm⁻²
ada:ablationDurationPerSpotDefault: N/A (line scan run 1) / N/A (spot run 2 — duration set by 34 runs covering 400 µm + washout, not a fixed spot duration)
ada:carrierGasAndFlowRateDefault: He: MFC-1 0.19 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.22 l min⁻¹
ada:coolantGasFlowRateDefault: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.90 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2)
ada:rfPowerDefault: 1000 W (run 1 major elements + run 2 trace elements)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: GRM block (3–5×) → unknowns → GRM block (3–5×); same structure for run 1 and run 2
ada:dwellTimePerMassDefault: Run 1 (major): 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 18; duty cycle: 2.069 s; Run 2 (trace): 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 7; duty cycle: 2.062 s
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: Run 1: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans; Run 2: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans
ada:internalStandardApproach: Run 1 (major elements): sum-of-oxide normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅=100 wt%; Liu et al. 2008); Run 2 (trace elements): single element IS from Run 1 (⁵³Cr concentration from major element run used as IS for trace element run)
ada:internalStandardElement: Run 1: No single IS; oxide sum normalization; Run 2: ⁵³Cr (concentration from Run 1 major-element analysis on 30 µm spot used as IS for 130 µm spot trace element run)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Run 1: Oxide sum normalization corrects for ablation yield variation; external calibration using glass GRMs (NIST + USGS + MPI-DING); Run 2: Cr from run 1 as IS corrects for ablation yield; external calibration with expanded glass GRM set
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time-resolved signals inspected manually; unstable intervals at start and end discarded; Cr heterogeneities and inclusion signals (elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni) identified and excluded from integration
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each analysis (5 scans); average background value preceding each analysis subtracted from corresponding data
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrectionsAppli: Yes — cool plasma not applicable (normal plasma); argide corrections less critical; oxide interferences monitored; spectral interference list in Table C1
ada:interferingSpecies: Same interference list as mapping (Table C1); argide-based interferences less critical without cool plasma
ada:interferenceCorrectionMethod: Argide corrections less critical (normal plasma); oxide-based interferences minimized by tuning; same interference list but without cool plasma mitigation
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: Same glass GRM set as mapping for Run 1; expanded set additionally includes MPI-DING KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G, ATHO-G, BM90/21-G, GOR128-G, GOR132-G for Run 2 trace elements
ada:calibrationStandardMeasurementFreque: Same as mapping protocol; GRMs at start and end
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: Same GRM set measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment
ada:detectionLimitMethod: Longerich et al. (1996); LOQ = 10SD criterion (same equation)
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: LOD calculated per analysis (Na=24, Nb=5); precision not formally reported as separate metric
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Trace element accuracy verified against literature INAA and EPMA data; major elements verified by comparison with EMPA results from same section

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Pre-ablation pass: 150 µm square, 2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 300 µm s⁻¹ scan before trace element spot run; removes surface contamination and re-deposited material

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Manual inspection; analyses with elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni (phosphate or metal inclusions) excluded; Cr heterogeneities also flagged

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Applied: Run 1 medium resolution with Faraday for major elements; Run 2 low resolution; cross-calibration performed

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: 10 µm s⁻¹ (line scan run 1); spot mode (run 2)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up: 0.947 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2); N₂ not added

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Longerich et al. (1996) for LOD; uncertainty for concentrations not formally described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Three-stage sequential design on same olivine location: (1) Pre-ablation pass (2 J cm⁻², 150 µm square, 300 µm s⁻¹) to remove surface contamination; (2) Run 1 — major elements (30 µm circular, MR M/ΔM=4000, 20 Hz, 7 nuclides); (3) Run 2 — trace elements (130 µm circular, LR M/ΔM=300, 40 Hz, 36 nuclides; Cr from run 1 as IS)
